0.original: Guildmaster Geva wishes to evaluate your progress.

1.original: In order to evaluate your progress, Geva instructs you to prepare three leather chokers. Craft the items as requested and present them to her.

2.original: Geva declares your workmanship satisfactory─for a jobbing leatherworker. She rewards you with an amateur's awl and reminds you to work hard if you wish to rise from obscurity and become a famous <hex:02081BE905FF0C637261667473776F6D616EFF0A6372616674736D616E03>.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※The next leatherworker quest will be available from Geva upon reaching level 10.

48.original: Getting used to that knife I gave you? Gods know it doesn't happen very often, but you've chanced to find me unoccupied. How about you show me what you've learned?

49.original: Let's see you make three leather chokers.

50.original: After all, there's more to our craft than simply tanning hides, and chokers are just about the simplest things one can make.

51.original: You'll need circles of leather and animal sinew to accomplish this task. Osgyth can provide the sinew, and I'm sure you recall the method for making leather.

52.original: I hope your technique has improved since last time.

53.original: Now, while we have an ample stock of skins, there are other means of procuring your materials.

54.original: Hunting for your own pelts, for instance. Aye, I know what I said about that before. But that was about assuming it was <hex:021A020203>necessary<hex:021A020103>. <hex:021A020203>Choosing<hex:021A020103> to do so is another matter. Indeed, it may teach you to appreciate the source of your livelihood.

55.original: Not all leatherworkers are wont to choose this method...but you are an adventurer, are you not?

56.original: When you've finished your work, bring your chokers here for inspection.

58.original: I suppose there is no denying that these are leather chokers.

59.original: If truth be told, an opo<hex:021F0103>opo could've achieved similar results given skins, sinew, and time.

60.original: Oh, but I don't mean to make light of your efforts. You fulfilled the order precisely as requested─a job well done.

61.original: Now then, I will teach you something to supplement your learning.

62.original: Through physical training, the body can be made strong and resistant to injury. Not so the throat, which ever remains a vulnerable point.

63.original: Although a leather choker provides less protection than a metal gorget, its simple design makes it ideal for everyday applications.

64.original: This simplicity also makes it an ideal choice for beginners practicing basic techniques─and for guildmasters assessing their progress.

65.original: As you are, you would make a passable leatherworker─one among the nameless multitudes who scrape a living out there. Whether you rise to become something more is contingent upon your efforts.

66.original: Consider this amateur's awl a reward for your efforts.

67.original: You will find it an indispensable partner to the head knife as you continue your training.

68.original: Now, I must return to my work. If you chance to find me unoccupied again, mayhap I will teach you something else.

69.original: Till then, keep your nose to the grindstone!

71.original: A higher craftsmanship rating hastens the progress of synthesis; greater control increases the chance of creating high-quality items; and additional CP improves your crafting stamina.

72.original: Outfitting yourself with an eye to your current objective will increase the efficiency of your crafting endeavors.
